acceptance_criteria.condition: The paired experiment is frozen before any formal trial and includes all 20 registered tasks with fixed hashes and randomized condition order.
Each formal trial runs in a separate workspace, exposes hidden cases only to the scorer, permits changes only to buggy.py, and is counted only when the Agent exits successfully.
A timed-out agent cannot leave descendant processes running, and runner checks do not generate Python bytecode or user-site imports.

invariants: Formal effect claims use only completed paired hidden-repair observations.
The baseline and Skill conditions differ only by Skill activation and its invocation instruction.
Interrupted, timed-out, scope-violating, or missing trials remain recorded and cannot be silently excluded.
A hidden-passing candidate from an interrupted Agent run is incomplete, not a successful trial.
A pilot or single task is not evidence of an overall model improvement.

safeguards.name: preregistered hidden-contract scoring
safeguards.rationale: The scorer reads hidden cases outside the repair worktree and records an independent pass/fail report.

safeguards.name: process and environment isolation
safeguards.rationale: Each condition uses a fresh temporary Git workspace, a killed process group on timeout, and disabled user-site/bytecode behavior.

safeguards.name: paired randomized inference
safeguards.rationale: The analyzer fixes one pair per task, deterministic order from the registered seed, task-cluster bootstrap, and paired sign-flip testing.

design_boundary.rationale: The analyzer owns eligibility and inference; the runner owns materialization, execution, scope checks, and artifact capture.

dependency_audit.rationale: Only existing Codex CLI, Git, Python standard library, and project scripts are used; no new package dependency was added.

extension_decision.rationale: The experiment adds no public extension point.

data_ownership.rationale: Corpus metadata and agent outputs are owned by this experiment; hidden cases remain scorer-only artifacts.

error_model.rationale: Timeout, nonzero agent exit, public failure, hidden failure, and scope violation are recorded as non-passing outcomes.

contract_evolution.rationale: No application API or persisted schema changes.

operational_budget.rationale: Agent, public-test, scorer, and statistical workloads have explicit timeouts and fixed resample budgets.

threat_boundary.rationale: Repair agents are forbidden from hidden tests, references, prior outputs, Git history, and external resources; native isolation is explicitly limited.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The protocol and runner are frozen in Git before formal collection and will be delivered as an atomic verified change.

release_recovery.rationale: This is an offline evaluation artifact, not a deployable service.

data_migration.rationale: No production data or schema is migrated.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No credentials or runtime secret values are stored.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: The QuixBugs source commit and license are pinned in the corpus manifest; no runtime dependency is introduced.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The preregistration, prompts, manifest, scorer, runner, and README document how to reproduce and interpret the experiment.

reproducibility.rationale: Model/Harness IDs, corpus/scorer/prompt/Skill hashes, seed, order rule, and fixed task plan are committed before collection.

independent_review.reviewer: pending formal review after paired trial collection
independent_review.notes: The pre-run protocol and runner safeguards have passed local verification; the final result remains pending formal data.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Frozen v4 20-task paired effect protocol with actual model/Harness IDs and optimized Skill hash.
Paired Codex runner with process-group timeout cleanup, controlled environment, sequential condition order, and explicit trial-complete gate.
Regression tests for timeout cleanup, environment isolation, and registered pair order.
Paired analyzer rejects incomplete trials instead of counting a timed-out candidate as a failure or success.
Pinned v3 QuixBugs split with a larger hidden remainder and task hashes.
Deterministic v3 split derivation from the pinned v1 ordered cases.
Combines only the frozen preregistration and complete runner trials into a completed record.

remaining_risks: The formal paired experiment has not yet collected trials, so no repair-success or model-wide causal claim is currently supported.
Codex native execution is protocol-isolated but is not a container security boundary.
QuixBugs algorithmic repairs may have a ceiling effect and may not represent production causal debugging.
